title: Nexus CoreWorkflowSubscribeRequest
description: Open one authorized subscription to a durable workflow run's bounded event stream. The subscription streams the same retained/live frames the run's ring already holds; it is not a second event dialect.

run_id.description: Root durable workflow run id (the session id the public inspect returns). A child session id is never accepted: ancestry is resolved from stored state, never from the caller's string.

last_event_id.description: Exclusive resume cursor `<UUID epoch>:<decimal sequence>` from a previously delivered frame, passed verbatim.
